Freeze complete geometric house calculation, original Regiomontanus/Argolus directions formulas, Swiss ephemeris files and requested-returned flags
Freeze natal time input/uncertainty, all original chart features and directions with SHA before exposed life-event outcomes
Explicitly label fitting/rectification event set and EXCLUDE all of them from holdout scoring
Define untouched dated holdout event targets in advance, including null/no-event windows and failures
Freeze exact forecast date/time windows, event signs and allowed abstention behavior before data reveal
Score with proper loss/probabilities when calibrated and matched baseline calendars, demographic and seasonal controls
Compare randomly shifted birth times and wrong-person charts; report all abstentions and negatives
Do not let claims of 2–3 degree uncertainty become a free post-hoc timing tolerance of years
